text:
jena: starting v2.10.1 deploy to us-west, window 21:30-22:15 PT. We'll toggle feature-flag 'new-route' in tiny cohorts (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%). @deploy-bot please queue.

deploy-bot: Job D-130900 queued by jena for 21:30 PT. Plan: 1%/10%/50%/100% with 5m holds. Telemetry tags attached.

marc: rollback triggers?

jena: abort if 5m error rate >2x baseline OR sustained p95 >400ms OR visible 5xx >=0.6%. Emergency commands: `deploy-bot abort D-130900` then `scripts/pin_version.sh router v2.10.0` and `scripts/disable_flag.sh new-route`.

ops-bot: Muting low-priority alerts for 40m from 21:25 PT. Critical alerts remain.

sylvie: note  if only one shard misbehaves, we'll flip that shard to legacy via `flags.exclude_shards=[<id>]` instead of full rollback. Keep shard-exclude cmds ready.

deploy-bot: step1 executed @21:30:18  cohort=dev-canary (1%).

marc: +3m: small p95 blip to 360ms for 45s, recovered. errors unchanged. Proceeding to step2 in 90s.

deploy-bot: step2 executed @21:39:05  cohort=beta (10%). holding 5m.

sylvie: +2m into step2: shard s-42 showing elevated errors. Applying exclude_shards=[s-42] for beta and re-running smoke.

deploy-bot: Applied flags.exclude_shards=[s-42] for cohort=beta. action=partial-exclude.

marc: post-exclude smoke PASS. p95 back to normal. We'll hold remaining 3m then evaluate for 50% ramp.

jena: good mitigation. If any further shard trends repeat across cohorts, we abort and pin. Hands on deck for the 50% ramp.

(End of thread)
